description: Parse a date to ISO date, validity and Unix midnight. Ambiguous numeric dates need format. to adds signed days between; omit date for UTC today. Deep adds calendar details on every plan.

date.description: The date as you have it, any common format. Omit for today (UTC)

deep.description: Include optional detail on every plan.

format.description: Breaks the month-first / day-first tie on numeric dates like 03/04/2026

lang.description: Optional display language, such as fr or zh-Hant. IDs, numeric values and input parsing stay unchanged.

to.description: Another date. Appends to (normalized ISO) and days (signed days between)

name: date
